paragraphs: The AMG GT 63 uses the M178 — a 4.0-litre V8 biturbo petrol engine developed by AMG. It was introduced with the R190-generation AMG GT in 2023 and remains the flagship powertrain for the model range (alongside the GT 63 S's higher-output version of the same engine). The M178 is AMG's "hot-vee" V8 design, with the turbos mounted inside the V of the engine for improved throttle response and packaging.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every AMG GT 63 on the road.

cards.body: A 4.0-litre V8 biturbo fitted to the AMG GT 63 from 2023 to present. Known for oil leaks from valve covers and coolant system wear over time — see the callout above. We replace valve cover gaskets, coolant components, and bearings as standard on every M178 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The AMG GT 63 uses the M178 V8 across all R190-generation cars. However, there are differences in output tuning between the GT 63 and GT 63 S variants — our rebuild process accounts for the specific engine management and hardware specification of your car.
